steps.text: Talk to Prince Itzla Arkan at the Teomat. You can travel here using Renu the quetzal.
Travel on Renu to the Quetzacalli Gorge.
Talk to the Bartender in the pub in the Gorge.
choices: I'd like to rent the basement room.

steps.text: Rest in the bed in the south-eastern room of the pub.
Talk to Prince Itzla Arkan in the bedroom.
Talk to the shopkeeper east of the pub.
choices: I hear you can offer help to those in need.

steps.text: Return to Prince Itzla Arkan in the bedroom.
Travel past the proudspire to the east to the Tower of Ascension. Talk to the prince there.
Before going to the tower, build the landing site in the north of the salvager overlook.
Talk to the prince at the Tower of Ascension to the south-east of the salvager overlook.
Talk to Nova outside the tower.
Talk to Sergius outside the tower.
Talk to Felius outside the tower.
Talk to Caritta outside the tower.
Talk to the prince at the Tower of Ascension to the south-east of the salvager overlook again.
choices: Could you remind me what Ximoua is?

steps.text: Talk to Forebearer Janus inside the tower.
Climb up the staircase in the tower to the first challenge.
Pickpocket one of the emissary ascended.
Use the key to open the gate in the south-east corner of the room.
Search the south-east chest for a book and some paper.
Read the poem.
Talk to the prince in the room.
Open the north-west chest.
Inspect one of the scraps to combine them.
Read the completed note.
Talk to Janus and tell him the passcode.
Talk to Forebearer Janus, ready to fight.
Defeat the waves of enemies. Use Protect from Melee. You can heal yourself and the prince using bandages from the chests in the area.
Talk to Forebearer Janus again to progress to the third trial.
Talk to the prince in the room.
Talk to Tenoch.
Talk to Silia.
Talk to Adrius.
Talk to Eleuia.
Accuse Tenoch.
Accuse Silia.
Accuse Eleuia.
Accuse the guilty individual.
Talk to Janus to go to the final trial, ready for a fight.
Defeat the prince. Use protect from melee. See sidebar for more details.

Defeat the prince. Use Protect from Melee. He will protect from any special attacks you do. He can do a sword swipe to turn off your prayers. Simply re-activate them straight away. If he says he's doing a slam attack, step on the tile behind him to dodge it.
Talk to Janus to wrap up the final trial.
Talk to Janus at the bottom of the tower.
Search the chest in the south of the tower for some emissary robes.
Talk to the prince to have him follow you.
Enter the temple to the east of the tower for a cutscene.
Talk to the prince in the temple.
Talk to Forebearer Fides in the temple.
Go down the stairs south-east of the temple. Be equipped for a fight.
Take a pickaxe from the nearby barrel.
Mine the nearby rocks.
Pull the lever in the south-east of the area. Make sure to avoid the wall spikes.
Climb down the ledge east of the lever.
Climb back up the ice to the south-west to pull the first lever.
Climb across the ice ledge to the north. Avoid the floor spike traps on the way.
Climb back across the icy ledge.
Climb back up to pull a lever you missed.
Pull the lever in the north-east room. Avoid the floor traps.
Jump over the frozen platforms to the north-west, and climb down the ledge there.
Pull the third lever in the north-west room.
Pull the final lever in the south-west, near the gate.
Pull the chain to unlock a shortcut.
Climb down the shortcut chain to the west of the entrance.
Search the urn with an air symbol on it near to the earth markings in the south-east of the area.
Search the urn with an earth symbol on it near to the earth markings in the south-east of the area.
Search the urn with an water symbol on it near to the water markings in the south-west of the area.
Search the urn with an fire symbol on it near to the water markings in the south-west of the area.
Fix the broken air statue in the west of the area.
Fix the broken water statue in the west of the area.
Fix the broken earth statue in the west of the area.
Fix the broken fire statue in the west of the area.
Inspect the air markings in the north-east of the area.
Inspect the water markings in the south-west of the area.
Inspect the earth markings in the south-east of the area.
Inspect the fire markings in the north-west of the area.
Activate the first statue in the order.
Activate the second statue in the order.
Activate the third statue in the order.
Activate the fourth statue in the order.
Enter the door to the west, ready for the boss.
Defeat Amoxliatl. See the sidebar for more details.

Defeat Amoxliatl. Use Protect from Magic. Ice spikes will appear on the floor, move off the tile to avoid them. She may disable your prayers and shoot an icicle at you. Simply turn back on Protect from Magic. Ice blocks may appear. Use melee to destroy them all before they explode and heal the boss.
Talk to Servius, Teokan of Ralos in the palace in Civitas illa Fortis to complete the quest.
Open the chest using the code from the book.
